artboards.title: Read first — 4 domains · what exists · order · 8 guardrails

annotations.text:
Sales CRM Restructure — Master UX/UI + Functional Architecture
Four core domains: Lead · Sold Deal · Agency · Visit
The top-left sheet is the one to read first — what already exists, and the impact level of each change
Static mockups. The figures are illustrative; nothing is wired to an API.

The rule that governs everything here — disturb the existing workflow as little as possible
Add columns and tables; never drop one or change what it means
A folded page redirects, it is not deleted
Anything the config tables already handle must not be hard-coded
Every release step must be reversible

Build order set by the owner — do not reorder
Business Rule → Data Model → Workflow / State → Information Architecture
→ Wireframe → UI Design → API → Development → Migration → UAT
Never start from Figma or the screens

Already in production — do not rebuild it
bookings = the sold deal (closer · agency · quota · commission_pct)
deal_stages + kanban-stages.ts = a funnel editable from config
office_visits = the central visit · tasks = the task engine · deal_timeline = activity
audit_logs = field change history

Five phases, one PR each
1 Core Sales → 2 Financial → 3 Commission → 4 Agency & Visit → 5 Cleanup
Phase 5 touches what people see every day, so it goes last
